comments.body:
### Separate the ClickLock description from its link

**Severity:** `medium`

The localized description ends with a period, but the hyperlink run follows immediately with no separator, so the rendered text can run together. Insert a space-only `Run` before the hyperlink.

```suggestion
                                            <Run Text=" " />
                                            <Hyperlink Click="OpenMouseSettings_Click">
```
